versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-mongodb-health-inspect 0.0.1-beta.1

- Initial release supporting read-only health inspections for Alibaba Cloud MongoDB (DDS) instances.
- Standardized HTML report generation for Sharding and ReplicaSet architectures across single-instance, multi-instance, and account/region-level scopes.
- Single-command operation covers instance discovery, data collection (DDS, DAS, CMS), and report creation.
- Detailed usage decision tree, command assembly guidance, enforcement of strict forbidden actions, and security/permission requirements.
- Pre-checks for Aliyun CLI version and credential configuration.
